definition: For EVERY world predicate P, diagonal validity of Agreement P implies its necessitated validity. This is a semantic schema over P, not an unrestricted object-language substitution or a theorem about a historical modal calculus.
note: Analyst formulation for issue #1049. Neither naming/context policy nor metaphysical applicability is defended. SEP Modal Logic §§10/16 is navigation only; attribution deferred. No new modal calculus or reality claim.
